verdict.rationale: Warp is a payroll product, so year-end W-2/1099 generation is a fair question. The pack only shows automated state tax registrations, filings and payments, plus an agent that handles tax notices. Those are adjacent tax-compliance features; nothing in the pack shows W-2s or 1099s being generated or distributed to workers at year-end.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
